I can't confirm that. Our policy says a lost parcel gets a free replacement or a full refund, but it doesn't say the replacement ships Express. Express is only guaranteed in the wrong-item case, so I don't want to promise it.

- **Express generally:** it normally costs $14.95 and isn't available in Zone 3 (over 1,000 miles, remote and island addresses).
- **Live plants:** they ship Monday to Wednesday only, so timing depends on when the investigation ends.
- **Next step:** if you'd like to ask for Express on the replacement, I can pass the request to a Support Lead. I can't promise the outcome.

The replacement only comes into play once the courier investigation (up to **5 business days**) confirms the parcel is lost, and I need your order number to open it. Please send it (LF- followed by six digits) and no card details.

I can also add the one-time goodwill store credit of up to **$15** for the delay if you'd like it.
